job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior GenAI Engineering Manager to lead our team in developing innovative artificial intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI engineering and a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge projects. This position is based in the company name=Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Ltd., industry=.



Roles and Responsibility




Lead the development and implementation of AI models and algorithms to drive business growth.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for AI adoption and improvement.


Design and develop scalable data pipelines and architectures to support AI model deployment.


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and develop tailored AI solutions.


Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI technology.


Mentor junior engineers and provide guidance on best practices in AI engineering.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Azure.


Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to analyze complex data sets.


Strong communication and collaboration skills.


Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to changing priorities.
